# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty years old when first introduced
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c20 P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds (over-harbor)  <sub>[v2 c9 P34](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c6 P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott is a tall, broad-shouldered, fine-looking man with a strong, clean-shaven chin, a Roman nose, and frank gray eyes. For fifteen years, he let his brown hair and beard grow uncut and unshaven down to his knees as part of a political vow, making him resemble a Viking of elder days. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he retained his dark blue eyes, red hair, and massive build.

_Sources: [v1 c20 P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025), [v2 c16 P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c35 P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is an intense, fiery, and stubbornly opinionated man who holds unyielding political convictions. Despite a fiery temper and a habit of loud, stormy outbursts, he possesses a great deal of wit, intelligence, and humor, enjoying a good argument or story. He is deeply protective of women and children, becoming enraged at any mistreatment or insult directed toward them. Underneath his loud and rebellious exterior, he is a kind-hearted, generous neighbor who holds fast to his promises.

_Sources: [v2 c9 P39](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0039), [v2 c16 P8](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0008), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P59](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0059), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079)_

## History

Marshall Elliott grew up over-harbor in Four Winds. In his youth, he courted Ellen West for two years, but they broke off after a bitter quarrel; in a fit of pique, he married Hester Reese, who later died. During a heated general election fifteen years prior to the events of the late four-winds period, Marshall swore a public vow that he would not cut his hair or shave his beard until the Liberal party won power. True to his stubborn nature, he maintained this wild appearance for fifteen years, cultivating a river of brown beard and long hair that made him famous throughout the district. After the Liberals finally won the federal election, Marshall immediately went to the Glen village barber at midnight to be shaved and barbered. Clean-shaven and rejuvenated, he rekindled his courtship with Ellen West, whom he had loved all his life. After resolving her family complications and sister's broken vow, Ellen accepted his proposal, and the two were married in a double wedding alongside her sister Rosemary and John Meredith.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c21 P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)_

## Quotes

> When I want parsons or pill-dosers I'll send for them. Till I do I'll have no truck with them.  <sub>[v5 c16 P49](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0049)</sub>

> I made a fool of myself and I'm sorry. Man can't say fairer. Forget and forgive. Shake hands, girl—shake hands.  <sub>[v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059)</sub>

> I never sulked in my life—it's just one big flash and crash with me and then—pouf—the squall's over and the sun is out and you could eat out of my hand.  <sub>[v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079)</sub>
